Class PptxAutoLink

java.lang.Object
com.cloudofficeprint.RenderElements.RenderElement
com.cloudofficeprint.RenderElements.PptxAutoLink
public class PptxAutoLink extends RenderElement
Class representing an AutoLink element for templates. This element can replace a tag in a template with a hyperlink or plain text.
